34360: In a poor neighbourhood of Istanbul, a young homeless girl has been found dead. Six people from the neighbourhood are being interrogated. While the police camera is recording, these six witnesses find themselves caught in manipulation and abuse, forcing them to give away their innermost secrets.
34616: When Irene takes a position at a hotel deep in the woods of the Austrian Alps, she soon discovers the girl she replaced vanished without a trace.

Arthur had done the final graces on him when he came back to life as Mr. Jack the Pumpkin Man. The Kellys proliferated through the years, and when some devil-may-care teens accidentally unleash Jack-O, young Sean Kelly must stop him somehow as his suburban world is accosted and the attrition rate climbs
35128: The past catches up with a ruthlessly ambitious boxing promoter.

35640: A pioneering ceramic artist Clarice Cliff rises to prominence in the 1920s while working in Britain’s Stoke-on-Trent pottery industry.
Her pottery made history, her story broke every rule.

How the right to vote went wrong.
36408: When Daniel and Isabelle invite Patrick and his new flame, Emma, to dinner, it’s with some misgivings. He’s instantly smitten with the seductive woman...
36664: The mother died under the executioner's axe; the daughter rose to become England's greatest monarch -- the brilliant and cunning Queen Elizabeth I. 36920: A guard vanished on his first night at an old psych hospital in 2023. His bodycam footage shows unexplainable incidents that continue to baffle investigators.
37176: A disgruntled researcher injects his former employers' meal with a serum that turns their sushi into flesh-eating monsters.
37432: A vengeful Southern sheriff is out for blood after his wife is brutally killed by a pair of drifters. Low-budget film set in Georgia in 1953 and at the time of release, purported to be based on a true story.
They're on the bad side of the wrong man.
37688: 1945, on an old cargo ship somewhere deep in the Pacific ocean: Captain Morton strives to become commander, so he demands the maximum quality of work from his crew, without granting them any freedom or favors - ignoring that they're thousand of miles away from the front. Following in the hilarious fun-steps of "Mister Roberts"
37944: Longtime retired couple Stella and Gerry realise that their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.
A day they can't forget. A truth they can't escape.
38200: Young Charlie begins to develop cold feet as his wedding looms nearer. Desperate to throw the plans off-track, he tries a variety of tactics, including attempting to rekindle the relationship between his fiancée, Josephine, and her former boyfriend.
You are cordially invited to join the confusion at...
38456: Travel plans for three men go horribly wrong with a race against time to return Luke home.
38712: In an oppressive future, where everyone's only contact is their computer, one lonely young man is forced to venture forth in search of human contact.
The World As He Knew It Is Over
38968: Based on the alleged autobiography of gay peruvian talk show host Jaime Bailey. 39224: When lapsed Jew and former cardiologist Harry suddenly decides to spend his retirement as a pig farmer in Nazareth, Israel, the move deeply shocks his family and his new neighbours. 39736: A humble fisherman from Rameswaram lives a quiet life with his family until he finds a gold pendant washed ashore. What initially seems like a blessing soon turns into a nightmare when false accusations threaten his peace and dignity, forcing him to stand up against a powerful system.
39992: A facially disfigured and mentally unhinged man wreaks his revenge on those he blames for his condition.
No woman was safe from his crushing arms...

40504: After a surprise phone call interrupts his daily workout, beefy body builder Naoto agrees to meet his photojournalist ex-girlfriend to help with her research on haunted houses. 40760: In 1890, the year of the U.S. census, chaos erupts when a stranger named Strindler arrives in a small town in Arizona and requests money for providing the names of dead Mexican laborers. Adapted from the novel by Nikolai Gogol.
41016: Liza falls in love with one of her father's employees. Her socialistic ideas about employment drive her to collide with her father and the sociopolitical status of the time.
41528: One-time gangster Antoine is enjoying retirement on the coast, now managing a boating club. He receives a visit from a former accomplice who asks for a loan. The money will be repaid by a crook who is now in hiding; Antoine intends to recover his money.
41784: Eyüp works relentlessly under the blazing sun during a tomato harvest in southeastern Turkey, driven by the urgent need to settle an impending debt. After a clash with his supervisor, he roams the city in search of a radical solution.
42040: This cinematic journey into the waters off East Africa chronicles the story behind artist Damien Hirst's massive exhibition of oceanic treasures.
42552: Four adventurers descend to the bottom of the sea. When their surface tether snaps, they find themselves marooned in a network of underwater caverns.
See women trapped in fantastic caverns at the center of Earth!
42808: Santa's daughter gets a chance to attend college for one semester in the 'real' world before heading back to the North Pole to fulfill her duties under her father.
43320: An ex-con finds his plan to go straight foiled by a loan shark who manipulates his target into taking on one last heist.
His every crime is a work of art.
43576: A mother of two gathers her loved ones to celebrate her birthday in her big house near the Loire Valley. The festivities are disrupted by the arrival of her daughter, who is known for her unpredictable outbursts.
43832: During the final throes of the last Carlist war, a little girl is rescued from an orphanage by a mysterious woman who lives deep inside the forest.
Not all stories are for children

But little did he know then, about Baagirathi or the misadventures that awaited the gang on their revenge quest.

She's a natural born fighter… back to school!

In this one, she gets hold of a magic lamp.
Scheherazade's story will be told once again.

François van Vliet / Bruno von Lippe

Ursula Andress will melt your thermometer.
